Top 10 targets

Top 3 overqualified plays

Roles where the posting asks for less than your resume already shows, the pay still clears $75K, and nobody will hand you a coding test. Filtered on purpose: none of these three require you to write or ship production code.

01

Customer Success Operations Manager

You are already the Gainsight power user these teams go out and hire. The work is declarative — health scores, automation rules, dashboards, data hygiene — not engineering. One search tip that's worth real money: look for “Customer Success Operations,” not “Gainsight Administrator.” The admin title averages around $73K, while roles listing Gainsight as a skill average closer to $108K for the same work.

$95K – $125K
Over-qualified
02

Renewals Manager — enterprise SaaS

You renew $7M in ARR across 140 accounts right now. Most postings ask for three to five years of renewals or account management and no technical depth whatsoever — you bring both. Base plus incentive, no code, and your QBR track record is the thing that separates you from career renewals reps.

$85K – $125K + incentive
Over-qualified
03

Technical Support Manager / Escalation Manager

Listings routinely want five years in a technical support organization plus some leadership. You have seven years of support across two product lines and a stint directly managing implementation specialists and coordinators at Ideal. The 97% First Call Resolution rate is the number that closes this interview — lead with it.

$90K – $125K
Over-qualified
Programming bar: none of the three ask you to build software. Config, process and people work — your SQL and JSON familiarity is a bonus here, not the requirement.

Top 10 targets

Ranked by how fast your current resume can convert, not by prestige. Bands are US remote base ranges for entry-to-mid postings as of July 2026 — verify against each posting.

Top 3 overqualified plays

Roles where the posting asks for less than your resume already shows, the pay still clears $75K, and nobody will hand you a coding test. Filtered on purpose: none of these three require you to write or ship production code.

01

Customer Success Operations Manager

You are already the Gainsight power user these teams go out and hire. The work is declarative — health scores, automation rules, dashboards, data hygiene — not engineering. One search tip that's worth real money: look for “Customer Success Operations,” not “Gainsight Administrator.” The admin title averages around $73K, while roles listing Gainsight as a skill average closer to $108K for the same work.

$95K – $125K
Over-qualified
02

Renewals Manager — enterprise SaaS

You renew $7M in ARR across 140 accounts right now. Most postings ask for three to five years of renewals or account management and no technical depth whatsoever — you bring both. Base plus incentive, no code, and your QBR track record is the thing that separates you from career renewals reps.

$85K – $125K + incentive
Over-qualified
03

Technical Support Manager / Escalation Manager

Listings routinely want five years in a technical support organization plus some leadership. You have seven years of support across two product lines and a stint directly managing implementation specialists and coordinators at Ideal. The 97% First Call Resolution rate is the number that closes this interview — lead with it.

$90K – $125K
Over-qualified
Programming bar: none of the three ask you to build software. Config, process and people work — your SQL and JSON familiarity is a bonus here, not the requirement.

Top 3 overqualified plays

Roles where the posting asks for less than your resume already shows, the pay still clears $75K, and nobody will hand you a coding test. Filtered on purpose: none of these three require you to write or ship production code.

01

Customer Success Operations Manager

You are already the Gainsight power user these teams go out and hire. The work is declarative — health scores, automation rules, dashboards, data hygiene — not engineering. One search tip that's worth real money: look for “Customer Success Operations,” not “Gainsight Administrator.” The admin title averages around $73K, while roles listing Gainsight as a skill average closer to $108K for the same work.

$95K – $125K
Over-qualified
02

Renewals Manager — enterprise SaaS

You renew $7M in ARR across 140 accounts right now. Most postings ask for three to five years of renewals or account management and no technical depth whatsoever — you bring both. Base plus incentive, no code, and your QBR track record is the thing that separates you from career renewals reps.

$85K – $125K + incentive
Over-qualified
03

Technical Support Manager / Escalation Manager

Listings routinely want five years in a technical support organization plus some leadership. You have seven years of support across two product lines and a stint directly managing implementation specialists and coordinators at Ideal. The 97% First Call Resolution rate is the number that closes this interview — lead with it.

$90K – $125K
Over-qualified
Programming bar: none of the three ask you to build software. Config, process and people work — your SQL and JSON familiarity is a bonus here, not the requirement.
